info.title: Floor plan extraction API
info.description:
Extracts rooms, walls, openings, stairs and the gross floor area (GF) from floor plan sheets: PDF, images (JPG, PNG, TIFF) and DXF.

**Prototype: for demonstration purposes only, not for productive use.**

### Two APIs

- **Workflow**: the endpoints the web app uses. Upload a sheet, confirm the building area and the scale, run the extraction, fetch the results. Open, no token. Every sheet is deleted 60 minutes after its last request (also across restarts); new sheets are limited to 6 a minute per address.
- **Batch (preview)**: many sheets in one job, without the confirmation steps. Needs an API token (`Authorization: Bearer <token>`). Tokens will come with the login of the web app; until then every batch request is answered with `401`.

### Batch processing, step by step

1. `POST /api/v1/batches` creates a batch and sets its rules: the areas (the detected floor plans), the scale (the proposal when its confidence is high enough, else a fixed `px_per_m`) and the exports.
2. `POST /api/v1/batches/{batch_id}/sheets?name=…` adds one sheet, the file as the request body; once per file.
3. `POST /api/v1/batches/{batch_id}/start` queues the batch. Each sheet is analysed, its floor plans are taken as detected, the proposed scale is taken or the sheet stops with `needs_scale`, and the extraction runs.
4. `GET /api/v1/batches/{batch_id}` reports the state of every sheet: poll it, or give a `callback_url`.
5. `GET /api/v1/batches/{batch_id}/results` returns the exports of all sheets as one ZIP. `DELETE /api/v1/batches/{batch_id}` removes the batch at once (it is deleted automatically after 60 minutes otherwise).

```sh
TOKEN=…   # from the login, later
API=https://plan-extract.ch/api/v1
B=$(curl -s -X POST $API/batches -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"name": "Building 2051"}' | jq -r .id)
for f in *.pdf; do
  curl -s -X POST "$API/batches/$B/sheets?name=$f" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
       -H "Content-Type: application/octet-stream" --data-binary @"$f"
done
curl -s -X POST $API/batches/$B/start -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
curl -s $API/batches/$B -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"            # repeat until "done"
curl -s $API/batches/$B/results -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -o results.zip
```

get.summary: The state of a batch and its sheets

delete.summary: Delete a batch and its files

post.summary: Add a sheet to a batch
post.description: The file is the request body; one request per file. Only while the batch is open.

201.description: The sheet, waiting for the start.

409.description: The batch has started; sheets can no longer be added.

post.description: Each sheet: analysis, the detected floor plans taken as they are, the proposed scale taken when its confidence reaches `min_confidence` (else the batch's `px_per_m`, else the sheet stops with `needs_scale`), extraction, exports.

409.description: Already started, or no sheet added.

get.summary: The exports of all sheets as one ZIP

200.description: One folder per sheet with the chosen exports, and `batch.json` with the state of every sheet.

409.description: The batch is not finished yet.

post.description: The file is the request body (PDF, JPG, PNG, TIFF, BMP, GIF, WEBP, DXF, DWG with a converter; up to 300 MB). Creates a sheet job and queues its analysis: the layout of the sheet, then the scale cues of its floor plans. Poll `GET /api/sheets/{id}` until `status` is `ready`.

429.description: More than 6 new sheets a minute from this address.

200.description: The demo sheet, or null when the server has none.

post.summary: Start a sheet job from the demo sheet

429.description: More than 6 new sheets a minute from this address.

get.description: With `rev`, the revision the client holds: `{"unchanged": true}` while nothing changed, so polling is cheap.

200.description: The job, or `{id, rev, unchanged: true}`.

delete.summary: Delete a sheet job and its files
delete.description: A job the worker is busy with is deleted as soon as the worker is done with it (`pending: true`).

post.summary: Confirm the area, scale or selection of drawings
post.description: Merged per drawing key (`<package>/<drawing>`) into the job's confirmations.

post.summary: Read the scale cues of drawings again
post.description: The analysis reads the scale cues inside the detected areas of the floor plans. This is for a changed area or another drawing; with `doors: true` the scale is estimated from the width of the detected doors (rough).
Stages 2 to 10 of the pipeline for the drawings confirmed for extraction, at their confirmed area and scale. About a minute per drawing.

text_ahead.description: Whether the text of every selected drawing was (or is being) read ahead: the run is shorter then.

get.summary: The geometry found so far while a drawing is extracted

200.description: Walls, openings, stairs, rooms and GF so far, in pixels of the working image; `{"stage": null}` before the first stage.

get.description: Rooms (name, number, net and gross area, stamp area, confidence, geometry), walls, openings, stairs, voids, the floor figures (GF), the room connections and the QA findings, in plan metres.

200.description: One row per room, with its review state.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: A file named in the job or its results: the preview, the working image, the overlay, the JSON, DXF, Excel or IFC export.

parameters.name: download
parameters.description: Send the file as an attachment.

get.summary: A file of the sheet job
The log of the sheet job
What the pipeline needs, and whether it is there
The queue and the worker right now
get.description: For monitoring: sheets waiting or running per lane, what each worker does and for how long, free disk and the server's memory.

queue.description: Work items waiting in both lanes.

queued.description: Waiting per lane: light (analysis, scale step), heavy (extraction, read-ahead).

processes.description: Whether the heavy lane runs in worker processes.

busy.description: Sheets analysing, scaling, queued or running.

working.description: What each busy worker does; null when all are idle.

bearerAuth.description: An API token from your account in the web app (Log in). Not issued yet: every token is refused for now.

FileName.name: name
FileName.description: The file name; its extension decides how the file is read.

BadRequest.description: The request cannot be carried out; the message says why.

NotFound.description: No such sheet job (or it was deleted), route or result.

Unauthorized.description: No API token, or not a valid one (none are issued yet).

WWW-Authenticate.description: `Bearer realm="plan-extract"`, with `error="invalid_token"` when a token was sent.

code.description: Names the error for a client that shows its own text (the web app translates it).

queue.description: Only while the job's work waits in a queue: its place and the expected wait, which move while the record does not.

ahead.description: An extraction whose drawing text was read ahead.

doors.description: A scale step that searches door widths.

position.description: While the work waits in its lane: jobs ahead of it.

wait.description: While it waits: seconds until a worker is expected to take it.

analysis.description: Per page (package): the regions of the sheet and its drawings with their kind, area and scale proposal.

results.description: Per drawing key: the output files, the summary (rooms, GF) and the timings.

polygon_px.description: The building area in sheet pixels; null for the detected one.

px_per_m.description: The confirmed scale: sheet pixels per metre.

measured.description: A measured distance: px, distance, unit, p1, p2.

scale_pending.description: The scale cues are being read (again).

scale_area.description: The area the scale cues were read in; null for the detected one.

area_net_simple.description: Net area of the simplified polygon (the wall-graph face minus the wall bands).

gross_basis.description: Where the gross polygon comes from: a closed face of the wall graph, or the pixel partition when the graph is not closed there.

geometry.description: GeoJSON polygon in plan metres (the exact outline at the wall faces).

geometry_simple.description: The simplified net polygon (few vertices), when the wall graph closes around the room.

geometry_gross.description: The gross polygon to the wall axes.

centre_line.description: GeoJSON line string in plan metres: the wall axis, snapped into the wall graph.

rooms.description: The room on each side of the axis ("outside" for the facade, null when none).

host.description: The wall segment that holds the opening.

facade_half_wall.description: The outer half of the facade walls: GF = sum of the gross areas + this band (+ faces no room owns).

area.description: The building area of each floor plan: as detected.

min_confidence.description: The lowest confidence of a scale proposal that is taken without a person.

px_per_m.description: The scale for sheets whose proposal is below `min_confidence`; without it they stop with `needs_scale`.

outputs.description: The exports to write. `pdf`, a report with the plan, the figures and the room list, is planned and not written yet.

callback_url.description: Called with the batch (POST, JSON) when it is finished.
